Maya Chen: Quick sync — landing hero + benchmark badge test for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Aim to freeze copy Thu EOD.
Sam - copy: Ill draft three hero variants per page: developer-first, performance-first, trust-first. Will keep Hosted lean.

Jon Kim: Infra flagged a provisional stat for Dedicated: ~180k tokens/sec per cluster (TBR). Also add SLA microline: "SLA-backed uptime + configurable autoscale."
Riley (growth): Routing rules sketch: Hosted -> self-serve signups; Dedicated -> AE queue; Private -> AE + security. Immediate AE if keywords: "compliance", "HIPAA", "SOC2", "on-prem". Map UTMs: ?utm_source=site&utm_campaign=tri_mode_test&utm_content=variantA -> SFDC queue.
Maya Chen: CTA A/B pairs: Hosted: "Start free" / "See benchmarks"; Dedicated: "Request pricing" / "Schedule capacity review"; Private: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief". Include ?source=landing in all links.
Sam - copy: Posting first-pass hero + subline + two CTAs here in 2 hours. Will keep hero copies short — avoid heavy numbers on Hosted control.
Riley (growth): Ill post routing YAML and the UTM->queue mapping after copy lands.
